scientific_scope.anatomy: right arm only: humerus, radius, ulna, seven explicitly repaired derived P2 muscle belly volumes; no torso, whole-body anatomy, hand mesh or skin
scientific_scope.left_view: stored fixed-angle reduced resting coordinates, live evaluated tissue geometry and initialized finite audits; gold authored tendon routes and teal authored shared interpolation scaffolds
scientific_scope.right_view: same atlas bones and reference tissue, same angle, authored linear bone-weight comparison
scientific_scope.actual_computation_during_capture: Loads saved resting coordinates; evaluates tissue/apparatus configuration, naive weighting comparison and browser reduced residual, finite surface/routing and sampled penetration rechecks; renders real WebGL. No new nonlinear time step or dynamics trajectory.
scientific_scope.qualifications: Finite fixed-angle reduced equilibrium and discrete audit receipt only. Recorded support torque holds the joint; the displayed 0.50kg glyph does not establish unsupported dynamic equilibrium.
limits: No patient or subject-specific calibration, independent anatomical validation, measured fibre or tendon attachment validation, or clinical claim.
Authored tendon guides have fixed routing topology; not sliding wrapping or finite-radius tendon contact.
Teal triangles are interpolation scaffolds, not resolved aponeurosis solids.
No cartilage, skin, physiological force–velocity or local tissue inertia; point-mass dumbbell has schematic shape.
Finite sampled surface/path gates do not certify grazing, coplanar or continuous-motion contact.
Independent Arm26 force-target fits are not tissue-material validation; existing fitted-stress/local-J warnings are retained in the unchanged full-page evidence and adjacent caption.
No new Lean compilation or full-book qualification from this screenshot.
